title: Stacks
blurb: A digital library for the folders on your device: PDF, EPUB, CBZ/CBR, DOCX, DOC, MOBI, FB2, text and image folders become 3D books as thick as their page count. Drag books into stacks, swipe through a stack, and read in 3D with page turns or flat, one page or two at a time. A save file remembers your stacks.
controls: Add a folder. Drag a book onto another to stack (long-press first on touch); drop at an edge to reorder. Tap a stack to swipe through it. In the reader: drag or tap pages to turn, 3D/Flat and 1/2 pages up top, Aa for text size, manga direction and pairing. In Chrome or Edge here, linked folders rescan by themselves and get a stacks-library.json save file.
